author: Kushal
problem: Read N, P, Q, R and a sequence A of N positive integers. Print Yes if A contains three back-to-back contiguous segments whose sums are P, Q and R in that order, otherwise No.
bug_description: Uses w >= N instead of w > N, so a third segment that ends at the last element is rejected.

comments.accurate: Uses prefix sums and binary search to look for back-to-back segments summing to P, Q and R
comments.wrong_behavior: Looks for back-to-back segments summing to P, Q and R that end before the last element
comments.wrong_location: Bounds checks on y, z and w verified; check that bisect_left is the right search for equal prefix sums
